hadiths.english: Actions are judged by intentions
Religion is sincerity
Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy
Purity is half of faith
The best of you are those who are best to their families
Whoever cheats is not one of us
Righteousness is good character
Your smile to your brother is charity
Whoever remains silent is saved
Allah is beautiful and loves beauty

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
hadiths.transliteration: Man salaka tareeqan yaltamisu fihi ilman sahhalallahu lahu tareeqan ilal jannah
hadiths.english: Whoever follows a path to seek knowledge, Allah will make a path to Paradise easy for him

hadiths.arabic: لا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ
hadiths.transliteration: La yadkhulul jannata man kana fi qalbihi mithqalu dharratin min kibr
hadiths.english: No one who has an atom's weight of arrogance will enter Paradise

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadiths.transliteration: Man kana yu'minu billahi wal yawmil akhir falyaqul khayran aw liyasmut
hadiths.english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَلَا أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ
hadiths.transliteration: Innallaha la yanzuru ila suwarikum wala amwalikum walakin yanzuru ila qulubikum
hadiths.english: Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but at your hearts
Fear Allah wherever you are
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr al-Ghifari (RA) and Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA)

hadiths.arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
hadiths.transliteration: Ahabbul a'mali ilallahi adwamuha wa in qalla
hadiths.english: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small
The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful

hadiths.arabic: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ
hadiths.transliteration: Iyyakum waz-zann fa innaz-zanna akdhabul hadith
hadiths.english: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ لا يَشْكُرِ النَّاسَ لا يَشْكُرِ اللَّهَ
hadiths.transliteration: Man la yashkurin nas la yashkurillah
hadiths.english: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah
Protect yourselves from the Fire even with half a date

hadiths.arabic: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى
hadiths.transliteration: Al-yadul ulya khayrun min al-yad as-sufla
hadiths.english: The upper hand is better than the lower hand
Do not belittle any good deed
The best among you are those with the best manners
Truthfulness leads to righteousness

hadiths.transliteration: Wa innal kadhiba yahdi ilal fujur
hadiths.english: Lying leads to wickedness
The best of people are those most beneficial to others
hadiths.source: Al-Mu'jam al-Awsat by al-Tabarani; graded Hasan by al-Albani

hadiths.english: Fear Allah and be just among your children
A believer is the mirror of his brother

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
hadiths.transliteration: Innallaha yuhibbur rifqa fil amri kullihi
hadiths.english: Allah loves gentleness in all matters
The strong is not the one who overcomes people by strength

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
hadiths.transliteration: Innamash shadeedu alladhi yamliku nafsahu 'indal ghadab
hadiths.english: The strong is the one who controls himself when angry

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
hadiths.english: Allah has prescribed excellence in all things

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
hadiths.transliteration: Man dalla 'ala khayrin falahu mithlu ajri fa'ilihi
hadiths.english: Whoever guides to good gets a reward like the doer
A good word is charity

hadiths.transliteration: As-sa'i 'alal armala wal miskeen kal mujahid
hadiths.english: One who cares for the widow and the poor is like one striving in good
Whoever relieves a believer's distress, Allah will relieve his distress
Allah helps the servant as long as he helps his brother
Whoever conceals a Muslim, Allah will conceal him
Allah loves those who repent
A believer to another believer is like a building
Each part strengthens the other

hadiths.arabic: لا يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ
hadiths.transliteration: La yahillu li muslimin an yahjura akhahu
hadiths.english: It is not lawful for a Muslim to abandon his brother
The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it
Allah loves the righteous servant

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لا يَقْبَلُ إِلا طَيِّبًا
hadiths.transliteration: Innallaha tayyibun la yaqbalu illa tayyiban
hadiths.english: Allah is pure and accepts only what is pure
Whoever is deprived of gentleness is deprived of good
Modesty brings nothing but good
The world is enjoyment

hadiths.transliteration: Wa khayru mata'id dunya al-mar'atu as-salihah
hadiths.english: The best enjoyment of the world is a righteous spouse
Show mercy to those on earth
